method.score: Weighted technical rules normalized for available checks
method.tie_breaker: For equal risk-adjusted scores only, order by a cross-sectional percentile composite: 30% monthly 6-period return, 25% weekly 13-period return, 25% daily 60-period return, 10% daily 20-period return, 10% latest volume versus 20-day average; missing metrics are excluded and weights renormalized. This relative tie-breaker is provisional and not independently backtested.
method.sort_order: Risk-adjusted checklist score descending, relative momentum score descending, then monthly/weekly/daily momentum as deterministic tie-breaks.
method.risk_adjustment: Experimental heat penalty subtracted from technical score; ranked by adjusted score
method.eligibility: At least 200 daily, 26 weekly and 12 monthly candles, with latest daily data no more than 10 days old

warning: Technical screening only, not a buy/sell recommendation. The heat penalty and relative momentum tie-breaker are heuristic and have not yet been validated by historical strategy testing. Fundamental data, earnings quality, and development projects are not included in this technical-only ranking. Full TSE/IFB coverage has not been independently verified.
